---
title: "Plot all eclipses"
format: html
---

```{r}
source("R/plot_magnitude.R")
source("R/plot_path.R")
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
eclipse_data <- read_csv("data/formatted_eclipses.csv")
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

```{r}
#| message: false
#| results: asis
#| echo: false
lapply(1:nrow(eclipse_data), \(x) {
  cat(glue::glue("\n\n### {eclipse_data[x,]$Date} {eclipse_data[,]$Type} \n\n"))
  cat("\n \n")
  . <- eclipse_data[x, ]
  eclipse_date <- .$Date
  eclipse_type <- .$Type
  eclipse_magnitude <- .$Magnitude
  eclipse_url <- construct_url(eclipse_date, eclipse_type)

  tryCatch(
    {
      print(plot_magnitude(eclipse_magnitude, eclipse_type))
      print(plot_path(eclipse_url))
    },
    error = function(e) paste0("Error occurred: ", e$message)
  )

  cat("\n \n")
})
```


:::
